typeCouple.introTitle: What type of couple are you?
typeCouple.pf_fusion_d: You do almost everything together, and you love it. Evenings, weekends, the shopping, the little messages during the day: the other is everywhere, and that's your way of being happy. People around you sometimes say "you never see one without the other", and you take it as a compliment. This kind of couple gives a security few people know. You know you're not alone, ever.
typeCouple.pf_fusion_a: Each keep a little piece of life for yourselves: one evening a week, an activity, friends the other doesn't know too well. Not to drift apart, quite the opposite. An inseparable couple with nothing left to tell each other in the evening, because everything was lived together, is the only real risk you have. And then, the day one of you needs some air, they need to be able to say so without it being taken as rejection.
typeCouple.pf_complices_d: At yours, people laugh. A lot. You have ridiculous nicknames, jokes nobody else understands, and a bad day usually ends with an evening spent making fun of everything. Your friends love having you over: you're the couple people invite to make sure it goes well. It's light to live with, and it's precious. Plenty of couples would give a lot to get that back.
typeCouple.pf_complices_a: Humour is your strength, and it can become your hiding place. When a subject hurts, one of you makes a joke and the conversation stops there. Give yourselves, from time to time, a moment where making each other laugh isn't allowed: a question that weighs, a worry, something that has built up. You'll see that your bond handles serious things very well, when you let it try.
typeCouple.pf_libres_d: You each have your own life, and you come back to each other. Friends of your own, projects of your own, sometimes holidays apart, and it's no problem at all. You don't quite get couples who have to do everything together. What you share is chosen, not endured, and that's why you're glad to see each other again. A couple of independents often lasts a long time, precisely because nobody feels smothered.
typeCouple.pf_libres_a: Check from time to time that the independence is still a choice made by two, and not a habit that has settled in. The risk, for you, is becoming two flatmates who get along well. A fixed date just for the two of you, one evening a week with phones put away, is usually enough to keep the bond alive. And ask yourselves, once a year, whether the other still needs as much air as you do.
typeCouple.pf_batisseurs_d: You build. A flat, a project, a child, a business, a trip planned over six months: your relationship is heading somewhere, and that's what holds you. You talk about money without awkwardness, you make plans, you know roughly where you'll be in five years. It isn't cold, as people often think. It's a way of taking the relationship seriously.
typeCouple.pf_batisseurs_a: Keep room for what serves no purpose. An evening with no goal, a weekend decided on Saturday morning, a silly purchase. A couple of builders who have completed all their projects and find themselves, in the evening, not knowing what to talk about once there's no more building site, is more common than you'd think. The project is your engine. It mustn't become the only reason to stay together.
typeCouple.pf_equilibre_d: None of the four ways of living as a couple takes over at yours, and that's a result in itself. Depending on the period, you're inseparable, then each gets their air back, you laugh a lot, then you spend three months on a project. This flexibility makes life easy and lets you adapt to whatever comes. The only downside is that it's sometimes hard to say what defines you, to yourselves as much as to others.
typeCouple.pf_equilibre_a: Still, look at the two highest bars below, they're the ones that say most about you right now. And ask yourselves the question together: what does each of you need at the moment? A couple that can do everything sometimes ends up choosing nothing. Choosing a bit more, from time to time, won't do you any harm.
typeCouple.q1: A Sunday with nothing planned, what does it look like at yours?
typeCouple.q1a: We hang out together all day, without even thinking about it.
typeCouple.q1b: We end up doing something silly, and we're still laughing about it that evening.
typeCouple.q1c: Each of us does our own thing, and we meet up for dinner.
typeCouple.q1d: We use it to get on with whatever we've got going.
typeCouple.q2: Your friends, if they had to describe you in one sentence:
typeCouple.q2a: "They each have their own life, and it works."
typeCouple.q2c: "You never see one without the other."
typeCouple.q2d: "With them, you laugh the whole time."
typeCouple.q3: A night out with friends where one of you isn't invited:
typeCouple.q3a: The other one goes, and tells everything when they get home, impressions included.
typeCouple.q3b: That almost never happens, we're invited together or not at all.
typeCouple.q3c: The other one goes, and whoever stays uses the time to get things done.
typeCouple.q3d: That's normal, we each have our own evenings.
typeCouple.q4a: The trip we've been planning for months, notebook and budget included.
typeCouple.q4b: A week together, and a week each on our own, no problem.
typeCouple.q4c: A badly planned road trip where everything goes sideways.
typeCouple.q4d: Two weeks just the two of us, far from everything, nobody else.
typeCouple.q5: One of you comes home after a really bad day:
typeCouple.q5a: The other drops everything and stays with them all evening.
typeCouple.q5b: The other finds a way to make them laugh within fifteen minutes.
typeCouple.q5c: The other gives them some space, and we talk about it when they're ready.
typeCouple.q5d: The other listens, then we look together at what we can change.
typeCouple.q6a: Each our own, with a share for what's in common.
typeCouple.q6b: We have a budget, goals, and we talk about it openly.
typeCouple.q6c: Everything is shared, we don't count.
typeCouple.q6d: We don't talk about it much, we sort it out, and we laugh at our silly purchases.
typeCouple.q7: An argument, at yours, how does it end?
typeCouple.q7a: With a joke that one of us eventually lets out.
typeCouple.q7b: We can't stand being upset with each other, we make up within the hour.
typeCouple.q7c: We look for where it came from, and what we change so it doesn't come back.
typeCouple.q7d: Each of us goes to get some air, and we talk again once we've cooled off.
typeCouple.q8a: What's needed to get organised, and a kind word now and then.
typeCouple.q8b: Few. We have our days, we catch up in the evening.
typeCouple.q8c: Mostly silly stuff, photos, things that make us laugh.
typeCouple.q8d: Lots. We tell each other pretty much everything as it happens.
typeCouple.q9: A project together, right now, do you have one?
typeCouple.q9a: The project is us. The rest comes after.
typeCouple.q9b: Something not serious that we love planning.
typeCouple.q9c: We each have our own, and we support each other.
typeCouple.q9d: Yes, a big one, and we talk about it a lot.
typeCouple.q10: In ten years, how do you see yourselves?
typeCouple.q10a: Each with a full life of our own, and the other in the middle of it.
typeCouple.q10b: With what we've built, and the next step already in mind.
typeCouple.q10c: Still glued together, exactly like today.
typeCouple.q10d: Laughing at the same silly things, with a few more wrinkles.
typeCouple.q11: One of you takes up a new hobby:
typeCouple.q11a: The other teases them a bit, then comes to have a look.
typeCouple.q11b: The other takes it up too, of course.
typeCouple.q11c: We look together at how to fit it into the week.
typeCouple.q11d: The other is happy for them, and doesn't feel obliged to follow.
typeCouple.q12: What you miss most when you're apart for a few days:
typeCouple.q12a: The evening catch-up on what we did and what we're doing tomorrow.
typeCouple.q12b: Not much in the moment, and it's good to get back together.
typeCouple.q12c: Someone to send the silly thing we've just seen.
typeCouple.q12d: We miss everything, even the noise the other one makes in the morning.
typeCouple.q13d: A building site that's moving along.
typeCouple.q14: One wants to go out, the other wants to stay in:
typeCouple.q14a: One goes out, the other stays, and nobody makes a thing of it.
typeCouple.q14b: We look at what's planned for tomorrow, and decide.
typeCouple.q14c: We stay in, or we go out, but together.
typeCouple.q14d: We negotiate while laughing, and the funniest one wins.
typeCouple.q15: The sentence you hear most at yours:
